purpose: Machine-readable public-evidence due-diligence workflow for procurement, vendor risk, RFP, contract, and AI-governance agents.
checks: legal entity and official company identity
SLA/uptime claims and public status history
product/integration claims material to the purchase
pricing/contract term claims material to the purchase
missing evidence requiring internal vendor follow-up

recommended_routes.specialist: claim_verifier | security | privacy | legal | RFP | finance | human_review

scoring_guidance.low: Material public evidence exists and no high-severity contradiction is found.
scoring_guidance.medium: Important evidence is partial or several material questions remain open.
scoring_guidance.high: A high-impact contradiction, material incident, or major control/evidence gap is found.
scoring_guidance.insufficient_evidence: Public information is too limited for a responsible risk conclusion.

constraints: Public-evidence due diligence is not a substitute for confidential assurance reports, technical testing, legal advice, or regulated professional opinions.
Do not treat vendor marketing copy alone as independent verification.
Preserve source URLs and dates so another agent can audit the conclusion.
